text.description_html:
Acorn AI4BQ, Offset Spear Tip Cabinet Strap Smooth Iron Hinge

The 9" Offset Smooth Iron Cabinet Spear Tip Strap Hinge is suitable for light weight doors or cabinets. It is for doors whose face sits 3/8" out from the door frame. These are specially designed for use on batten or tongue and grooved doors. The old world charm is in both the spear tip design and in the smooth iron finish which is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it may have looked originally if it was forged a century ago. The Smooth Iron Cabinet Spear Tip Strap Hinge has a lifetime no rust warranty.

When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, Acorn can really make your home stand out.

Features for the 9 Inch Smooth Iron Spear Tip Cabinet Strap Hinge:

  • For doors whose face sits 3/8" out from the door frame.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Specifications for the Offset Spear Tip Cabinet Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Length: 9"
  • Width: 1-3/4"

Sold as a pair (2-hinges).
